name: Jiang Hu 江湖
description:
🎄English

Overhaul of how Tarkov can be played

🧮 In-Game User Interface

For new players, after install:

  • Press F5 to open Game Manager, most of configure settings are there
  • Press F12 and click “JiangHu”, some features are there
  • Click “Description”, it has overall mod info
  • All detailed guides have 7 languages versions

👥 Universal Bot Generator

  • One-click to spawn/remove any bot at any time, on any map, with any hostility
  • Option to disable all default bot spawns: Play only with your own bot teammates, enemies, or neutrals

⚔️ Bot War & Death match

  • Click 「樂園」 button on the main menu to play alongside bot teammates, against multiple enemy bot teams, with your own bot roster (all bosses, PMCs, Rogue, etc), in death match mode, on all maps
  • Switch to free camera mode to observe the bot battles, or switch back to rejoin the fight
  • In free camera mode, select and place bots on the map, like arranging pieces on chessboard

🍂 Random Map + Randow Transit + Hardcore mode & Quest Type

  • Click 「江湖」 button on the main menu to play, select map(s) in F5 game manager
  • “Dance on the Razor’s Edge”: Energy & Hydration drain at 1 point every 10 seconds + all boss kill XP reduced to 1000
  • “Aporia” Quests: Reach high XP targets within a single raid while playing with both. rewards skill levels, can reset anytime to earn more levels

🪽 New movement & handling - Martial Arts

  • Instant Response, Clean & Smooth Movement
  • Faster walk/sprint, stance transitions, leaning
  • Sliding, Mid-Air Jump
  • Faster weapon switching / aiming, no aimpunch
  • Wider freelook
  • Stellar Transposition: Instantly swap positions with any bot you are looking at
  • Kung Fu Bot: As you master each martial art (in Physics), bots will learn and use it too

🤖 Bot Highlight & Marker

  • In normal raid, highlight & mark bots by side, makes them clearly visible: green for teammates, red for enemies, white for neutral
  • In Bot war & Death match, highlight & mark each team with unique color
  • Can be toggled on/off anytime

🌌 New UI

  • New main menu: rearrange buttons, add 2 new game mode buttons, removed “alpha warning”
  • Background Selector: Set your video as dynamic background, or image as static background
  • BGM Player: Set your music as BGM, can play in hideout and raid too
  • Jiang Hu Art DLC

🎋 Battle Screen

  • Show detailed damage stats after every hit: which body part was hit and took how much damage, which armor/helmet was hit and how much durability was lost, and how much damage absorbed by armor/helmet
  • Kill record for each bot type: Scav, PMC, Boss, etc
  • In death match: displays each team’s K/D
  • Freely move and place the battle screen anywhere on the screen
  • Scroll to view raid history, and Automatically saves a copy to a local log file in BepInEx\plugins\JiangHu.Client\fight_log

🔮 Dogtag Collection Quest Type

  • New bot names: select from myths, literature, folklore, movies, anime, etc
  • Collect dogtags with specific nicknames to complete quests and recieve rewards

🏯 New Items & Trader

  • 1×1 size containers that can hold ANYTHING, fits in ANY slot
  • in-raid repair kits
  • Other unique pristine supplies
  • New Trader Buys ALL items at handbook price with roubles, giving you the best value and showing the true base value of every item

🪄 Random Quest Generator

  • Play randomized vanilla questlines

☯️ New Quest

  • Jiang Hu Bounty: Eliminate ALL bosses in one single raid. This is the only path to Prestige. you may attempt it at any time, even at Level 1. If succeed, you will become a true Jiang Hu Da Xia and may prestige immediately
  • 9 Main Quests: replace the vanilla questline, focused and intensified experience
  • Reward all around skill levels. all skills can reach elite level in 1 play through
  • Cover all vanilla quest unlocks, and unlock them by category per quest, such as items, recipes, traders & standings, customization

🎮 New Game Settings

  • Flea Market locked
  • Early access to Kappa
  • Cash Wipe on Death: Lose 10% of total cash each death, with the first 1 million always protected
  • No Insurance: Traders stop offering insurance
  • Eventually traders stop doing any bussiness with you at all, you must rely entirely on loot
  • Your security container will be disabled
  • And more

🌸 Story mode & Free Mode

  • In Story mode, start your journey as a Young Wanderer, take quests from the legendary Long Gate Inn, grow stronger, learn rare martial arts, earn powerful artifacts, and face increasingly dangerous challenges on your path toward the ultimate Jiang Hu Bounty
  • Combines many features above — settings, quests, new movement systems, etc — to deliver a completely different gameplay experience
  • In Free Mode, All features can be toggled on or off. turn all of them off will return to vanilla game. you can customize and explore your own Jiang Hu experience
  • Recommended: use one profile for immersive story mode and one for free mode

📱 Install & Use

  • Just like all mods
  • If playing with an existing profile, Back up your profile first
🧧 中文

塔科夫玩法的重造更新

🧮 游戏内用户界面

新手宝宝在安装模组后：

  • 按F5键打开游戏管理中心，大部分的设置都在那里
  • 按F12键点击“江湖”，那里也有一些重要功能
  • 点击“描述”，查看模组的综合介绍
  • 所有详细指南均有7国语言版本

👥 点将台

  • 一键召唤/移除任何人机，任意地图，任何时间，任何敌友关系
  • 可选禁止系统刷人机，只与自定义的队友、敌人或中立人机一起玩

⚔️ 乐园

  • 点击主菜单的「樂園」按钮，和人机队友一起，使用自定义的队伍阵容（所有头目、佣兵、反叛者等等），在所有地图上与多支人机队伍展开死斗混战
  • 可随时切换到自由视角观战，或切换回来加入战斗
  • 在自由视角下，可以选中并将人机放置在地图任何位置，就像下棋一样

🍂 全新模式与任务类型

  • 江湖行：随机地图 + 随机转图，点击主菜单的「江湖」按钮玩，在F5游戏管理器中选择地图
  • 惊鸿猎：能量与水分消耗调整为每10秒减少1点，击杀首领的经验统一下调至1000
  • 向阳而生：新任务类型，单次战局内达成高经验值目标，需开启“惊鸿猎”后点击“江湖”玩。奖励技能等级，可随时重置以获取更多等级

🪽 凌波微步

  • 瞬时响应、干净流畅的移动
  • 神行术：更快的行走/冲刺、姿态转换、侧身速度
  • 滑铲，半空跳跃
  • 更快的武器切换/瞄准，无瞄准受击晃动
  • 更宽的自由视角
  • 斗转星移：与视野中的任何目标瞬间互换位置
  • 功夫人机：随着你掌握每一门武功，人机也会学会并使用

🤖 画皮

  • 在普通战局中按阵营高亮人机身体以清晰识别：绿色为队友，红色为敌人，白色为中立
  • 在乐园死斗中用独特颜色高亮标记每支队伍
  • 可随时开启/关闭

🌌 新用户界面

  • 新主画面：重排按钮，新增2个新游戏模式按钮，移除“测试阶段警告”
  • 背景选择器：设置视频文件作为动态背景，或图片作为静态背景
  • 音乐播放器：设置音乐作为背景音乐，藏身处、局内也可播放
  • 江湖风格包

🎋 锋镝录

  • 每次命中后显示详细伤害统计：命中部位及伤害值，命中的护甲/头盔及其损耗的耐久度，以及被护甲/头盔吸收的伤害值
  • 每种人机类型的击杀记录：拾荒者、佣兵、头目等
  • 在混战死斗模式中：显示每支队伍的击杀/死亡比
  • 可自由移动并放置锋镝录在屏幕任何位置
  • 滚动查看战局历史，并自动保存副本至本地日志文件 BepInEx\plugins\JiangHu.Client\fight_log

🔮 狗牌收集任务类型

  • 新人机名字：从神话、文学、民间传说、流行文化（影视、动漫等）中选取的名字
  • 收集带有特定名字的狗牌以完成任务并获得奖励

🏯 新物品与商人

  • 1×1尺寸的神秘容器，可容纳任何物品、放在任何格子里
  • 战局内修理工具包
  • 其他独特的崭新补给品
  • 新商人“龙门客栈”以卢布按手册价格收购所有物品，提供最佳价值并显示每件物品的真实基础价值

🪄 任务生成器

  • 体验随机原版任务线

☯️ 新任务

  • 江湖悬赏令：在单次战局中消灭所有头目。这是转生的唯一条件。你可以在任何时间尝试，即使只有1级。 若成功，你将成为真正的江湖大侠，并可立即转生
  • 9个主线任务：完整替代原版任务线，提供更紧凑刺激的游戏体验
  • 奖励全面技能等级：所有技能可以在一周目达到精英等级
  • 一任务全解锁：特定任务可解锁完整类别，如物品、制造配方、商人及好感度、藏身处装饰

🎮 新游戏设置

  • 跳蚤市场锁定
  • 早期即解锁Kappa
  • 死亡现金惩罚：每次死亡损失总现金10%，但保底100万
  • 无保险：商人停止提供保险
  • 最终商人会彻底停止交易，你必须完全依赖战局战利品来生存
  • 禁用安全箱
  • 以及更多

🌸 剧情模式与自由模式

  • 在剧情模式中，开启萌新哈基米的旅程，从传奇的龙门客栈接取任务，逐渐变强，学习稀有武功，获得强大神器，应对日益艰险的挑战，最终剑指江湖悬赏令
  • 结合了前面介绍的众多功能——设置、任务、新移动系统等——提供全新的游戏体验
  • 在自由模式中，所有功能均可开关。关闭所有功能将回归原版游戏。你可以自定义并探索属于自己的江湖体验
  • 推荐：使用一个存档体验沉浸式剧情模式，另一个用于自由模式

📱 安装及使用

  • 和所有MOD的安装方法一样
  • 如果使用现有存档游玩，请首先备份你的存档
🌐 languages
  • 中文
  • English
  • Español
  • Français
  • 日本語
  • Português
  • Русский
🌟 Credits 感谢

  • BSG, SPT project and the community

  • Virtual’s “VCQL”, Bobby Renzobbi’s “Bobby’s Music Player”, Devraccoon’s “Environment Replace”, acidphantasm’s “Scorpion”, VAFELZ and Tiltushkin’s “All Ammo Trader”, Hood’s “More Energy Drinks”, ragnaroks’s “sptarkovammocraft”, crustyselenium_‘s “Flea Market Quests”, desze’s “Unlock All Hideout Customization”, VioletAmbush’s “VAI: Rogue-Lite Tarkov Project 1.1.1”, DrakiaXYZ’s “NoBossPMCs”, saryn’s “Oops.AllBossPMC”, Terkoiz’s “Skipper”, Chazu’s “[TTC] Tarkov Trading Cards”, harmony’s “Bot Callsigns - Reloadedand”, jbs4bmx’s “Special Slots”, kobethuy’s “Bring Me To Life - Revival Mod”, DrakiaXYZ’s BotDebug, kmyuhkyuk’s “Game Panel HUD”, pein’s “FPV Drone Mod”. Thanks Cj, DrakAI.xyz, Refringe at discord.

  • All the feedbacks and bug reports, Thanks ~ ❤️ 感谢大家的反馈和报错，么么哒~ ❤️

category.title: Overhauls
category.description: Large-scale mod packs that overhaul many game systems. Typically combines both client-side and server-side mods into one package.

versions.description:
🧩 Features

  • New unlimited mid air jump: you can jump all the way to the sky. added into story mode quest unlock
  • Restore “Disable Vanilla Bot Spawn” function

🧩 功能

  • 新增“筋斗云”：无限半空跳跃，可以一直跳到天上去啦。加入剧情模式解锁
  • 恢复“禁止系统刷人机“功能

✨ Wonderland Update

  • Select bot types → set the number of teams → set the bot count per team → click “乐园” to Play
  • Select from all combat capable bot types to build your own team roster.
  • Multiple teams playing death match, All teams are hostile to each other
  • Battle Screen’s Bot War Stats panel displays each team’s K/D.
  • Switch to free camera mode to observe the bot battle, or switch back to rejoin the fight.
  • In free camera mode, Select and place bots on the map, like arranging pieces on a chessboard.
  • Highlight & show each team with unique color (enabled in F12 menu)
  • Fixed and improved Jianghu bot hostility, now they will fight correctly

✨ 乐园更新

  • 选择人机类型 → 设置队伍数量 → 设置每队人机数量 → 点击“乐园”开始混战
  • 选择各种人机类型搭建自己和对手的队伍阵容
  • 多支队伍进行死斗游戏，各队彼此敌对，不存在同盟关系
  • 锋镝录的混战数据面板会显示每队的场上人数和歼亡比
  • 可以随时切换到自由视角观战，或切换回来加入战斗。
  • 在自由视角下可以选中并将人机放置在地图的任何位置，就像下棋一样
  • 每个队伍使用不同的画皮/草标颜色（F12菜单里开启）
  • 改进江湖人机的敌对关系，现在可以正确掐架了

✨ Visual Utility Update

  • Battle Screen

    • Show detailed damage stats after every hit: which body part was hit and took how much damage, which armor/helmet was hit and how much durability was lost, and how much damage absorbed by armor/helmet.

    • Kill record for each bot type: Scav, PMC, Boss, etc.

    • Freely move and place the battle screen anywhere on the screen.

    • Scroll to view raid history.

    • Automatically saves a copy to a local log file in BepInEx\plugins\JiangHu.Client\fight_log.

    • Default Hotkey: F8

  • Highlight Bot

    • Highlight bot bodies by side and Makes them clearly visible: green for teammates, red for enemies, white for neutral.

    • Can be toggled on/off anytime.

    • Configurable in F12 menu

🧩 Features

  • Fade-out effect when auto-pausing music upon entering a raid.

  • If the selected background file is missing, a random background will be used; if none exist, defaults to vanilla background.

  • Restored preventing friendly bots from firing back.

  • Restored resuming music/video after raid ends.

✨ 可视化工具更新

  • 锋镝录

    • 显示每次命中后的详细伤害统计：命中身体部位及造成的伤害，命中护甲/头盔及耐久损失，以及护甲/头盔抵挡的伤害量。

    • 击杀记录：包括细分显示各类型人机，如Scav、PMC、各个Boss等。

    • 可自由移动并放置在屏幕任意位置。

    • 可滚动查看战斗历史。

    • 自动保存一份本地日志副本在BepInEx\plugins\JiangHu.Client\fight_log目录下。

    • 默认快捷键: F8

  • 画皮

    • 按阵营高亮人机身体以清晰识别：绿色为队友，红色为敌人，白色为中立。

    • 可随时开关。

    • 在F12菜单里设置

🧩 功能

  • 进入战局自动暂停音乐时使用淡出效果。

  • 若选中的背景文件缺失，将使用随机背景；若无背景文件，则使用游戏默认背景。

  • 恢复防止友方机器人反击的功能。

  • 恢复战局结束后继续播放音乐/视频的功能。

✨ Bot Update

  • One-click to spawn/remove any bot at any time, on any map, with any hostility

  • Option to disable all default bot spawns, Play only with your own bots: teammates, enemies, or bystanders

  • Kung Fu Bot: As you master each martial art (in Physics), bots will learn and use it too

  • Indicator: Displays bot positions in raid so you can see teammates. (Warning: Additional settings exist for spawn confirmation & debug purposes; using them will affect gameplay experience)

  • Boss Notifications for Deathmatch, can also be used in normal raids

🧩 Features

  • Improved spawn system for Deathmatch bosses.

  • Automatically stop music when the raid starts.

  • Change to Bosses also using new nickname

✨ 点将台更新

  • 一键召唤/移除任何人机，任意地图，任何时间，任何敌友关系

  • 可选禁止系统刷人机，自定义所有的队友、对手

  • 功夫人机：随着你掌握每一门凌波微步武功，人机也会学会并使用

  • 局内显示： 局内显示队友位置以便配合。（小贴士：更多选项是为了确定召唤是否成功以及排错，游戏中使用会影响体验哦）

  • 头目提示：主要用于死斗模式，普通模式也能使用

🧩 功能

  • 优化死斗模式头目刷新

  • 战局开始前自动暂停音乐及视频音效

  • 改为头目也使用新名字

✨ Martial Art Update

  • Stellar Transposition: Instantly swap positions with any bot you are looking at😉

  • Mid-Air Jump: Allows one additional jump while airborne. Replaces “Jump Higher”

  • Fast Movement: Increased sprint speed

  • All configurable in F5 game rule manager, and are integrated into Story Mode rewards

🧩 Features

  • Added a world shaper setting to switch between playing music and video audio

✨ 武学更新

  • 斗转星移：与视野中的任何目标瞬间互换位置😉

  • 梯云纵：可以在半空中进行一次额外跳跃。取代“跳得更高“

  • 神行术：增加冲刺速度

  • 可在F5游戏规则管理器设置，并已整合到剧情模式奖励中

🧩 功能

  • 新增世界塑造器设置：可在播放音乐和视频音频之间切换

🧩 Features

  • Display Background in game loading & raid loading

🐞 Fixes

  • fixed an issue where weapon missing from modding screen

🧩 功能

  • 游戏载入和战局载入时也能使用新背景

🐞 修复

  • 修复一个武器改装界面看不见武器的Bug

🧩 Features

  • Display teammate positions during raids

  • Reduce PMC spawn failure chance. Notice: PMCs won’t spawn in Labyrinth

  • Teammates will not return fire if accidentally damaged by the player

  • Added notifications for spawn status and confirmation

🏮 Content

  • Added new bot names

🧩 功能

  • 局内可显示队友位置

  • 降低召唤队友失败的概率。不过无法在迷宫中召唤PMC队友

  • 队友在被玩家误伤时不会进行反击

  • 新增召唤状态与确认的系统提示

🏮 内容

  • 新增人机名字

✨ PMC Teammate Update

  • Press F8 to spawn a PMC teammate.

  • They appear at the nearest map entry point to your current position.

  • They are friendly to you and to each other, and hostile to everyone else.

  • Works in all modes, including Deathmatch (so we can play Team Death Match)

  • Hotkey can be configured in F12.

✨ PMC队友更新

  • 按F8可召唤一名PMC队友

  • 队友将出生在距离你当前位置最近的地图入局点

  • 与你为队友，彼此为队友，与其他所有人敌对

  • 所有模式都能用，包括死斗（这样就可以玩团队死斗啦）

  • 可在F12菜单自定义快捷键

✨ Deathmatch Mode Update

  • Play deathmatch against all bosses on all maps

  • All other bots are disabled, only bosses will spawn

  • Face 5 different bosses at the start of each match

  • When one dies, another one spawns. All 18 bosses will appear once each in a non-repeating random order.

  • Bosses are on the same team. They do not fight each other — they only hunt you.

  • If you defeat all 18, a new randomized cycle begins. The fight is endless.

  • When you die, you are instantly teleported to a random entry point on the same map, at least 60m away from your death spot.

  • Your HP fully restores, but negative effects (bleeding, etc.) remain — you must handle them yourself.

  • Default is 2 extra lives per match, 5 starting bosses, and 180 mins match. all can be configured in F5.

  • Click the 「樂園」 button on the main screen to play.

  • Uses the same random map pool as Jiang Hu Road.

🧩 Features

  • Add Cultist Priest to “boss brain bot”

✨ 乐园模式更新

  • 在所有地图上和所有首领玩死斗游戏

  • 不刷其他人机，只有首领

  • 每场比赛开始时面对5个不同的首领，当一个死亡时另一个入局，所有18个首领将以不重复的随机顺序各出现一次

  • 首领属同一阵营，他们不会互相攻击，而是一起围攻你

  • 如果击败所有18个首领，会开始新的一轮随机循环，永无止境

  • 凉凉时，你将被瞬间传送到地图上在当前死亡位置60米范围外的一个随机出生点

  • 生命值完全恢复，但负面效果（流血等）仍然存在，必须自己处理

  • 默认是三条命（新增两命），开局5个首领，对局时长180分钟。可以在F5里自定义

  • 点击主屏幕「樂園」按钮开始玩

  • 使用与江湖路相同的随机地图池

🧩 功能

  • 首领风格人机：加入邪教徒祭司的大脑

📌 Quest Adjustments

  • Added “Prologue – Labyrinth” and updated all Main Quests to include Labyrinth content. Remove unlocking vanilla Labyrinth quests and the Labrys Access Keycard recipe.

  • Updated “Prologue – Lab”.

  • Changed “Prologue” quests into a single-line progression.

  • “Big Tarkov Family” now requires completing “Prologue” to unlock.

  • DSP production is now unlocked at Intel Center Lv.1 by completing “Prologue – Shoreline”.

  • Skill rewards:

📌 Quest Adjustment

This mod was started with a simple idea: take the good parts of the vanilla quests, remove the bad ones, and rebuild them into a more focused questline, so we can have a much better experience. but in the prosess of doing so, it may risk to go beyond fun or hard, but annoying. to fix that, and make the questline more fun, we have this update:

  • Final quest is now a “Bounty” quest: we may attempt this quest anytime without any precondition, start from Level 1. Should you succeed, you’ll become the legend who achieved the impossible, and free to prestige immediately.

  • Remove “can’t use painkiller” requirement from “Big Tarkov Family” quest; move “can’t use medicine” requirement from “The Survivalist” to “Oasis - Professional 3”. From a gameplay perspective, handicap mechanics work well in short quests but poorly in long ones.

  • Downscaled kill requirements for most quests, and hideout level for “Home In Tarkov - Part 2” to keep the challenge while avoiding repetition.

  • updated info in f12 hub
